steps.body: A hundred more or less slides only the hundreds digit — an even bigger jump that is even easier to see.
steps.narration: A hundred more or less slides only the hundreds digit — an even bigger jump that is even easier to see.

widget.prompt: Hop by hundreds: two hops forward from 250.

commonLandings.feedback: Those hops moved by TENS. A hundreds hop slides the front digit: 250 → 350 → 450.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 100. From 250, 2 hops land on 450.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 450 — each hop slid the hundreds digit by one.

predict.prompt: One hundred less than 448: which digit moves?
predict.reveal: 448 drops to 348 — the 4 tens and 8 ones never move.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2b mental hundred.
invariants: Trading between places changes the FORM of a quantity, never its value — the model and the number must stay equal for g2b mental hundred.
misconceptions: Treating a trade as adding or removing amount instead of renaming the same total.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the blocks stop matching the written number?

widget.prompt: What is one hundred more than 171?

commonErrors.feedback: That moved one TEN; one hundred more changes the hundreds digit.
That added a single one — a hundred is a much larger jump.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Line the places up — hundreds with hundreds, tens with tens, ones with ones — and work one column at a time.

hints: Find which place the jump touches.
